title: Mahatma Gandhi Setu
visualBrief: Compact Gandhi Setu: twin through-truss decks,16representative Warren bays in each main closeup span, crossed roof bracing, concrete pier heads, outer walks, sparse lights/markings and shorter pony spans. Original detailed I-sections and hardware remain independently reproducible.

sourceFacts.supplierRecord: Dextra India engineering case study credited to its application engineer; original span schedule and retained piers.
sourceFacts.reviewScope: Original999896-triangle/81075924-byte master reproduced exactly; independent medium-fi shells use shared painted metal/concrete.

reconstruction.notes: Completed contractor photograph in the UMI2022 presentation page28 corrects the first draft: staggered Warren diagonals, inclined end posts, and short modified pier heads rather than the demolished concrete cantilevers. Member sizes, panel interpretation, cap dimensions, member spacing and pier ground profile remain photographic reconstruction. Original65.53/121.065m spans govern the source; published total5575m differs by3.985m from their sum.

geographicProposal.notes: The inspected aerial image shows pale through-truss steel, roof crosses, roadway and the paired crossing layout during replacement, with the opposite concrete flank still present in that picture. Current twin-steel state is retained from the existing2022 authored facts; the picture does not newly certify completion. Standard viewer PMTiles NH22/NH31 bridge roads and retained steel-span controls confirm the north/northeast axis, midpoint and5578.985m straight steel extent; longer curved southern concrete approach is excluded. Northern PMTiles road reference57.2162m at modeldeckY23.280217570340803 gives approximatebase33.9359824296592m. The mapped river preview uses an explicit approximate44.0223m surface, while raw terrain/water samples remain retained. Exact flood stage, foundation depths and endpoint joins are not surveyed.

appearance.identity: Twin pale-steel through-truss crossings on retained concrete piers; shorter pony end spans.
appearance.exclusions: Separate curved concrete approach, later neighboring bridge, engineering river datum and full hardware inventory.

limitations: Picture and standard viewer PMTiles approximate fit; no bespoke bridge survey, engineering drawing or datum research.

Original detailed master remains reproduced by its unchanged recipe and geometric map controls; compact source simplifies I-section profiles, bolts/gussets, bearings, floor/roof bracing and fittings into readable beams and shared metal/concrete materials.

Skyline merges paired piers/decks and representative outer trusses; district/street omit many truss panels and inner fine members, while closeup retains16main Warren bays. Road/paint markings are local flat materials; shared graphs are reused.

Reference aerial picture is an intermediate replacement state; existing twin-steel source facts are retained separately. River surface and northern-road contact use coarse PMTiles; exact flood stage, submerged foundations, approach joins and physical-device timing remain unmeasured. Footprint replacement off.
importReason: Preserve thin cables, rail frames and hardware across the full crossing; whole-object quantization loses these details.
